summary: Pin is on a steep bush slope; the usable spot is the public car park or kerb nearby.
reasons: Ring is 34% bush slope, no track
Car park and kerb parking about 80-90 m away

drivers.seclusion: No dwellings mapped; bush on one side, but a visitor car park with a building and many cars sits at the top.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed road and car park, with cars parked along the kerb in the QLD image; room for a van.
drivers.traffic: Busy visitor road and car park by day; likely quiet at night.
drivers.convention: Cars park along the kerb and in the car park; no campers seen.

flags: Ring area is extremely steep: about 34% mean grade
Mapped gate 161 m away, not on the only access
Likely popular daytime lookout, so rangers or signs possible
sun_shade: Car park has scattered trees; kerb lane is open to the sun, with bush shading from the east.
cannot_judge: Slope of the car park and kerb, as elevation samples cover only the ring

best_section.where: Kerbside parking lane or the sealed car park north-west of the ring, beside the visitor building
